OPERATOR RULING (recorded verbatim on the operator's behalf, resolving the 2026-08-17 RCA/design escalation): "Use the same region as the project's other resources [= us-east-1: .github/llm-providers/bedrock.toml records measured invocation in account 896586841071/us-east-1; external-integration.yml defaults AWS_DEFAULT_REGION and REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION to us-east-1; infra/runbooks/bedrock-access.md and compose defaults likewise]. Provenance labeling may interact with config wiring and env-var handling; to avoid regression and maintain portability across diverse environments, splitting provenance labeling (region_source=repo-config) into a follow-up task is approved."

Consequences for this ticket: (1) rebar.toml [llm] pins bedrock_region_name = "us-east-1" (NOT us-west-2 as the original Approach text proposed); (2) the provenance AC (region_source=repo-config) is amended to point at an approved follow-up task rather than this change; (3) env-var precedence (REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION over the table value) is preserved and pinned by test.
